verdict.rationale: Thoropass documents monitors that automatically check connected systems such as AWS, Azure and GCP for control compliance. It also claims to alert users to compliance violations and offers a Monitors page and dashboard for investigating violations and flagged controls. However, the alerting shown is in-app only, with no evidence of delivery to Slack, email or ticketing tools. Missing for 10: documented Slack/email/ticketing alert routing, detail on the context included in alerts, configuration drift detection specifics, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
